sources.author: Xiaojian Zeng
sources.title: Two-vertex cuts and a Lorentzian obstruction for bistable bipartite graphs
sources.scope: A fixed rank-three antiferromagnetic three-state target detects bistable bipartite sources with a two-vertex cut, including even cycles; the full source conjecture remains open.
sources.comparison: Our fixed positive rank-two triangle-free obstruction applies to all connected triangle-free noncliques, without bistability or connectivity-two assumptions. It does not claim the same coefficient formula for cuts.

sources.title: Blowup polynomials and delta-matroids of graphs
sources.checked: Definitions 1.1, 1.3, determinant formula in Remark 1.4, Theorem 2.3 and Corollary 2.4.
sources.comparison: The Lorentzian complete-multipartite characterization concerns a homogenized distance-matrix determinant in vertex blowup variables. Our fixed four-spin partition polynomial is a different invariant; this related result is credited, not claimed as new.
